name: Ichijou Shiori
source:
A third year at Seijou high school and president of the disciplinary club.
She lives with her sickly mother after her father died in a car accident and was able to enter the school through a scholarship because they were too poor. She's a determined, no-nonsense type person. Despite her somewhat rough character with people she doesn't like, her biggest wish is a peaceful school life.
